A man faces challenges and adventures.

Street of rogues... reporters... and romance!

35640: An attorney uncovers a political conspiracy in the brutal killing of a wealthy young woman.
In a world of lies, nothing is more dangerous than the Truth.

36152: The story of the journey of an adult hero to his Bata, a stern Russian peasant who became a father at the dawn of the nineties and raised his son the way all Soviet people did.
36408: Egon Olsen is the leader of the Olsen Gang. While he was in the slammer, he planned how he would steal the fantastic golden figure Keizeroppzatsen.

36920: Twenty-three years after her hooker mother tried to kill her in the womb Helen remains damaged psychological goods. 37688: Smitten with a Jewish woman, a gentile asks his Jewish pal to advise him on how to act like a member of the community.
The story of a gentile who wants to marry a Jewish girl... so he'll never have to make another decision.

Self / Calamity Jane / Claude Jade / Joan Arc
38200: A multinational expedition discovers a lost city beneath a pyramid, where they must stop the reawakened gods of ancient Egypt from initiating the apocalypse
An ancient pyramid. A present threat. A mystery unchained after 5,000 years
38456: Fatih and Kumru, a lawyer from different cities, team up for a case involving a cheating spouse. They spend 8 hours racing around Izmir gathering evidence, unexpectedly altering their plans and lives.
38712: A professional witness at the marriage registrar helps a runaway girl when her boyfriend does not show up for the wedding. He falls in love with her, but then the missing groom returns.

First they betrayed him. Then they gambled with his life.
39480: Set in Kashmir, the film follows an Indian Army officer who discovers that his estranged son has joined a militant group.
39992: What started as a simple escort mission will soon turn to chaos as the prisoners of Koh Kla take over the prison grounds. A special task force gets trapped in the prison will have to fight their way out for survival, to protect a key witness.
If You Give Up, You Die
40248: Former student Raskolnikov is pushed to murder when struggling to pay the rent on his apartment. When the murder is being investigated by the police, Raskolnikov struggles between trying to hide his guilt and the pressure to confess.

He has nowhere to go. They have nowhere to hide.

41528: Three small-time criminals take up an offer to rob one of the biggest jewellery shops in the city. Will they be successful in their attempt, given that the store's owner, a ruthless man, is aware of the plan?

Life is about keeping your head above water.
42040: On 27 July 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Népstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury.
42552: Between Alice, a hospital nurse and Aldo, a shampoo sales representative, things have turned sour of late. Alice blames her husband for lacking ambition and contemplates divorce.One day Aldo wins the ten million euro lotto prize. But, unwilling to share the bonanza, he keeps mum about it, all the more as he finds out Alice has an affair with Gérard, Aldo's former friend and ... new boss. However, Aldo, leading a double life, starts spending his money ...
42808: A sniper kills two prisoners in a police van, and the driver sets out to find the killer.

Jeremías must choose between this exciting but lonely new world he finds himself in or returning home to his loving family.
What does he want to be when he grows up?
43320: The gay son of a conservative senator who is also the poster boy for his father's re-election unknowingly befriends a gay activist bent on destroying the hypocritical campaign.

He was 15 – an innocent from a small village, soon to be trapped in the erotic underworld of Prague.
43832: Ameen and Haala’s marriage is arranged in a hurry. As Ameen tries to know Haala better before the wedding, she does not consider it important and this leads to a misunderstanding between the couple

44600: In Goa, two thugs, Pancho and Vinci, are approached by a crime boss, Don, with an offer to buy two precious stones, Laila and Majnu. However, these two end up initiating a gang war.

Information is like a bank. Our job is to rob the bank.

DxM takes the mind-bender thriller to the next level with an immersive narrative and breath-taking action.
A sub-atomic fight for the subconscious.

He's the dirtiest law-enforcer ever to hit the streets...

Of human laughter, wonder and tenderness !
46904: A surreal odyssey in which a melancholic maidservant crosses paths with a homicidal little boy, travels to a tiny island of pirates and encounters a man with multiple personalities.

47928: A conservative Muslim girl falls in love with an agnostic journalist.

In the second part, 10 years after the original series, Shiki and Mikiya's daughter, Mana Ryōgi, spends a day with Mitsuru.

They gave him the hands of a killer!

What would you do to save your child?

Reality will exceed your wildest fantasy

MEN BATTLE FOR THEIR LIVES... WOMEN FIGHT FOR THEIR LOVE... IN A MIGHTY SAGA OF CONQUEST ON INDIA'S FRONTIER

But Dr. Schemmer wants his son to become her husband.

Once you check in, you can never leave.

51512: In the near future the US Government has created an elite team of soldiers specially trained for action in the event of a hostile alien encounter. A multi-national force, they are the last line of defense
